summary: Log cabin from 1931 and a 40-foot L-4 tower from 1939; the tower was gone by 1953, and the 1931 cabin remains as a rental.

facts.status_note: The 1939 tower is gone; the 1931 log cabin remains and is on the Recreational Rental Program.

access.note: The cabin is on the Recreational Rental Program, according to Idaho Fire Lookouts.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as a hike-in rental.

events.note: Log cabin. Firelookout.com says it is still there.

evidence.quote: The cabin is on the Recreational Rental Program

evidence.supports: five miles north-northwest of Kelly Creek Ranger Station
evidence.quote: 5 miles NNW of Kelly Creek R.S.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says the lookout was abandoned in 1953 and the tower is gone; Idaho Fire Lookouts says the tower was removed that year. Both put the end of the tower at 1953 and agree the tower is gone while the cabin remains.

notes_for_editor: The 40-foot figure is converted to 12.2 m; the sources do not say whether it is overall height or to the cab floor. The 'still there' note on firelookout.com is undated, so the cabin's current state rests on that page plus the rental listing on idahofirelookouts.com. The Forest Service camping and cabins page checked does not list this cabin, so the rental booking route is unconfirmed. Record status 'gone' describes the tower, not the surviving cabin; the editor may want a status that covers a standing cabin. The access level 'restricted' is our reading of a rental program. No staffing or fire history found.
